Classes

BufferedDrawNode

BufferedDrawNodeSharedData

Contains data which is shared between all osu.Framework.Graphics.BufferedDrawNodes of a osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.

Component

An updateable component that can be inserted into the draw hierarchy. This is currently used as a marker for cases where nothing more than load, update, lifetime support and hierarchy presence are required. Eventually this will be fleshed out (and the inheritance will be reversed to Drawable : Component).

DrawNode

Contains all the information required to draw a single osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable. A hierarchy of osu.Framework.Graphics.DrawNodes is passed to the draw thread for rendering every frame.

Drawable

Drawables are the basic building blocks of a scene graph in this framework. Anything that is visible or that the user interacts with has to be a Drawable.

For example:

  • Boxes
  • Sprites
  • Collections of Drawables

Drawables are always rectangular in shape in their local coordinate system, which makes them quad-shaped in arbitrary (linearly transformed) coordinate systems.

DrawableExtensions

Holds extension methods for osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.

Colour4

Represents an RGBA colour in the linear colour space, having colour components in the range 0-1. Stored internally as a System.Numerics.Vector4 for performance.

DrawColourInfo

DrawInfo

MarginPadding

Holds data about the margin or padding of a osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable. The margin describes the size of an empty area around its osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable, while the padding describes the size of an empty area inside its container.

Interfaces

IBufferedDrawable

Interface for osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawables which can be drawn by a osu.Framework.Graphics.BufferedDrawNode.

ICompositeDrawNode

Interface for osu.Framework.Graphics.DrawNodes which compose child osu.Framework.Graphics.DrawNodes. osu.Framework.Graphics.DrawNodes implementing this interface can be used in osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawables.

IDrawable

Exposes various properties that are part of the public interface of osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable. This interface should generally NOT be implemented by other classes than osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable, but only used to specify that an object is of type osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable. It is mostly useful in cases where you need to specify additional constraints on a osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable, but also do not want to force inheriting from any particular subclass of osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.

ITexturedShaderDrawable

Interface for osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawables which can be drawn by osu.Framework.Graphics.TexturedShaderDrawNodes.
